note: In the Chapman area of Pachaug State Forest, Voluntown, near Mount Misery and the Rhododendron Sanctuary: wooded sites around a central field. Sites 24, 36 and 37 have limited electricity, which ReserveAmerica says is not rated for RV use. Two pets allowed per site. Cell service is extremely limited. --Claude
summary: ctparks + ReserveAmerica + 2009 map: $17/$27 confirmed; 22 sites, no RV hookups, 26 ft on every site (possibly a placeholder); composting toilets and drinking water; 2026 season Apr 10-Oct 12 confirmed (now manual); pin ~1.1 km off; note cleaned (booking, season and field-held text dropped).
flags: PIN: stored 41.5935,-71.8565 is on a tree farm beside Route 49, about 1.1 km east of the campground. OSM's campground way centres on 41.59302,-71.86924, and imagery shows the central field with the parking at its NE corner as on DEEP's map; the sites ring the field's west and south sides. Recommend moving the pin to 41.5928,-71.8701 (elevation may change with it). RA's own GPS (41.60139,-71.88583) is also off.

SITE LENGTHS: ReserveAmerica shows Max Vehicle Length 26 ft back-in on all 22 sites (site 019's details give no driveway length) - a uniform value that may be a placeholder, but it passes 23 ft either way.

BOOKING POLICY ROW: ReserveAmerica's Mount Misery page says reservations 'can be made online until 5pm on the day of arrival', while the CT row carries reserve_until 24 hours before arrival ('up to the day before arrival'). No walk-ins (fcfs never, stored manual) agrees.

ENDURO TRAIL (mentioned, not a drop candidate in my reading): ctparks says Pachaug 'offers a 58-mile enduro motorcycle trail for registered street legal motorcycles' that 'begins at the Enduro parking lot on Spaulding Road in Plainfield' and 'An ATV registration is not a valid type of registration to operate on our trail.' The campground is not named as staging or a trailhead for it.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): no water near the sites; the nearest stream is about 250 m east.
PHONE: 860-376-4075 confirmed (ctparks 'Forest office : (860) 376-4075'); RA says there is no camp office at Pachaug.
